data.define: A polite way to say no or that you're okay.

misuse.text: Don't say 'I'm good' if you want more food.

data.l1_hook: Biraz daha kek ister misin? "I'm good"

native.tip: “I'm good” = İyiyim. Örnek: “No thanks, I'm good.”
native.caption:
“I'm good” ne demek?
“I'm good” = İyiyim.
Örnek: “No thanks, I'm good.” (Hayır teşekkür ederim, "I'm good".)
